public_facts: Multicentre trial, ACRIN Cooperative Group with RTOG. FDG-PET before and after definitive chemoradiotherapy in stage III NSCLC.
Published objective: determine whether post-treatment FDG-PET SUV predicts long-term survival after definitive chemoradiotherapy.
TCIA imaging: 242 patients, 677-series-per-collection scale, modalities CR/CT/DX/MR/NM/OT/PT, 135.5 GiB.
Clinical data licence CC BY 3.0. Released as two random samples (75% / 25%) that recombine.
Nine forms named in the dictionary index ship no CSV (B1, CA, D1, NP, OC, R1, RS, X1, XS); all are RTOG-0214 forms, not 6668.
